exposure: Time period (specifically a period of staff shortages due to industrial action)
cohort: 494 neonates admitted with neonatal encephalopathy to Sally Mugabe Central Hospital (SMCH) in Zimbabwe between November 2018 and October 2019.
finding: Caesarean section, convulsions, lethargy, and Thompson score were significantly associated with neonatal death in neonates admitted with neonatal encephalopathy.
mod_finding: Emergency caesarean section was associated with increased mortality.
